title: Power up your AI infrastructure! A first look at the Smart Systems Stage agenda at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
excerpt: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the Smart Systems Stage will be where energy, infrastructure, and technology collide, covering everything from fusion breakthroughs to the grid strain AI is putting on the entire economy.
content_html:
AI doesn’t run on code alone — it requires massive amounts of power, and that demand is increasingly becoming a critical bottleneck. At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the Smart Systems Stage will be where energy, infrastructure, and technology collide, covering everything from fusion breakthroughs to the grid strain AI is putting on the entire economy.

From October 13-15 in San Francisco’s Moscone Center, join leaders from Commonwealth Fusion Systems, Helion, Inertia, Bloom Energy, and more as they dig into what it actually takes to power the next decade of innovation. We’re tackling everything from commercial fusion’s path, to the grid and why utilities and startups are racing to modernize aging infrastructure, to how data center operators are scrambling to secure the electricity that AI’s growth depends on.

We’re also closing in on the end of our current pricing window, so this is your chance to save on all of our tickets for founders, investors, and more — grab your ticket here before our current discounts are gone! As for the agenda at hand, let’s explore the Smart Systems Stage lineup so far:

Bringing Fusion to the Grid

Leaders from Commonwealth Fusion Systems and Helion break down the breakthroughs driving commercial fusion forward, the challenges still ahead, and what it will take to get fusion power onto the grid at scale.

With David Kirtley, CEO, Helion, and Brandon Sorbom, Chief Science Officer, Commonwealth Fusion Systems

How Twilio’s Founder Is Tackling the Power Problem

Inertia CEO Jeff Lawson joins for a candid fireside chat on his path from founding Twilio to leading one of the best-funded fusion power startups in the world — and how scaling Twilio is shaping his approach to talent, timelines, and the hard engineering questions ahead.

With Jeff Lawson, CEO, Inertia 

Rewiring the Grid for the Electric Age

Electricity demand is growing faster than the infrastructure built to support it. This panel explores what it takes to modernize the power system, where investment is flowing, and how utilities, startups, and technology providers are building a more resilient, flexible grid.

With Drew Baglino, Founder & CEO, Heron Power; Apoorv Bhargava, CEO and Co-founder, WeaveGrid; and more speakers to be announced

AI’s Power Problem

As compute demand skyrockets, data center operators and energy companies are racing to secure power and expand infrastructure before it becomes the bottleneck that slows AI’s next wave. Hear how leaders across both industries are tackling it.

With Sara Spangelo, President & Co-Founder, Ambrosia Energy; Bill Thayer, SVP, Head of Datacenter Solutions, Bloom Energy; and more speakers to be announced

Whether you’re building the next energy breakthrough, rethinking grid infrastructure, or just trying to understand what’s really constraining AI’s growth, the Smart Systems Stage is built for founders and operators who need the full picture — not just a headline and an LLM summary.

Plus, joining us at Disrupt 2026 means you can get access to every other stage, all of the networking, every side event, and the rest of our full speaker lineup. It’s a three-day deep dive in the heart of the startup community you’ll never forget, so register today!

content_html_zh:
人工智能不仅仅依靠代码运行——它需要大量的电力，而这种需求正日益成为一个关键的瓶颈。 在 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 上，智能系统舞台将是能源、基础设施和技术碰撞的舞台，涵盖从融合突破到人工智能给整个经济带来的电网压力等各个方面。

10 月 13 日至 15 日，在旧金山莫斯康中心，与 Commonwealth Fusion Systems、Helion、Inertia、Bloom Energy 等公司的领导者一起深入探讨推动下一个十年创新的实际因素。 我们正在解决从商业融合的路径到电网的所有问题，以及为什么公用事业和初创公司竞相对老化基础设施进行现代化改造，到数据中心运营商如何争先恐后地确保人工智能增长所依赖的电力。

我们当前的定价窗口也即将结束，所以这是您为创始人、投资者等节省所有门票的机会——在我们当前的折扣结束之前，在这里抢到您的门票！ 至于手头的议程，让我们探讨一下迄今为止的智能系统舞台阵容：

将融合带入电网

Commonwealth Fusion Systems 和 Helion 的领导者详细介绍了推动商业聚变向前发展的突破、仍然面临的挑战，以及如何将聚变发电大规模并入电网。

与 Helion 首席执行官 David Kirtley 和 Commonwealth Fusion Systems 首席科学官 Brandon Sorbom 合影

Twilio 创始人如何解决电力问题

Inertia 首席执行官杰夫·劳森 (Jeff Lawson) 与我们进行了一场坦诚的炉边谈话，讲述了他从创立 Twilio 到领导世界上资金最充足的聚变发电初创公司之一的历程，以及 Twilio 的规模扩张如何影响他处理人才、时间表和未来棘手工程问题的方法。

与 Inertia 首席执行官杰夫·劳森 (Jeff Lawson) 合影

为电力时代重新布线电网

电力需求的增长速度超过了为其提供支持的基础设施的增长速度。 该小组探讨了如何实现电力系统现代化、投资流向以及公用事业公司、初创公司和技术提供商如何构建更具弹性、更灵活的电网。

与 Heron Power 创始人兼首席执行官 Drew Baglino 一起； Apoorv Bhargava，WeaveGrid 首席执行官兼联合创始人；以及更多发言人即将公布

人工智能的权力问题

随着计算需求的飙升，数据中心运营商和能源公司正在竞相确保电力安全并扩展基础设施，以免其成为减缓人工智能下一波浪潮的瓶颈。 听听这两个行业的领导者如何解决这个问题。

与 Ambrosia Energy 总裁兼联合创始人 Sara Spangelo 一起； Bill Thayer，Bloom Energy 高级副总裁兼数据中心解决方案主管；以及更多发言人即将公布

无论您是在打造下一个能源突破、重新思考电网基础设施，还是只是想了解真正限制人工智能发展的因素，智能系统阶段都是为需要全面了解（而不仅仅是标题和法学硕士摘要）的创始人和运营商而构建的。

此外，加入我们的 Disrupt 2026 意味着您可以访问所有其他舞台、所有网络、每个会外活动以及我们完整演讲者阵容的其余部分。 这是一个为期三天的深入探讨创业社区核心的课程，您将永远不会忘记，所以今天就报名吧！

当您通过我们文章中的链接购买时，我们可能会赚取少量佣金。 这并不影响我们的编辑独立性。
